user.title: tuct/levoit air purifiers

menu_option_descriptions.general: Spare-filter stock, appliances, reset on done, pre-filter and dust-sensor tasks

data.prefilter_weeks: Or at the latest every … weeks

data_description.stock_enabled: One appliance “Levoit spare filters” with one part per filter type. Every filter replacement takes one off the stock. Off: deleted, or handed over to you if you counted stock on it.
data_description.appliances_enabled: Model, notes and the fitted filter on the device page, only where no appliance exists yet. Off: deleted, or handed over to you if you counted stock on them.
data_description.reset_on_done: When you tick off “Replace filter” in Home Keeper, the integration presses “Filter Reset” on the purifier.
data_description.prefilter_enabled: For every purifier. Off: the pre-filter tasks are deleted.
data_description.sensor_enabled: For every purifier with a dust sensor: every 2 months (Vital) or 3 months (Core 300S/400S/600S, EverestAir). Off: these tasks are deleted.
data_description.prefilter_hours: Needs a “Fan Runtime” sensor. Without one, only the weeks count.
data_description.prefilter_weeks: Levoit recommends every 2–4 weeks. Whichever comes first is due.
